paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.33% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.73%) and Hang Seng weakest (-0.73%). Brent crude changed -4.76% to 110.3. Gold changed -0.44% to 4,020.8. Bitcoin changed -0.07% to 79,951.6406. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.986%, a relative move of -0.04%. Among the firms tracked, Santander (-3.66%) and Vale (-3.23%) moved the most.
